headSubject: chore(ledger): close WMS-11 -- keyboard-only MVL entry verified live in browser
summary: Closed REG-216 (aggregate-root Selection panel's New button attempted a blank conceptMutation create that always fails; now routes client-side to the paired Workbench's empty-shell editor instead), added a live clock to the generated-app shell topbar (WMS-9 N4, platform-wide), and closed WMS-11 by driving a real keyboard-only multi-origin/multi-destination MVL entry in a browser (found the prior 'ambiguous' probe was a testing-methodology gap, not an engine bug -- no platform fix needed there).
nextStep: No specific carried-over step. Remaining open ledger items per ledger/session-state/open-state.md: SEC-11 (HIGH, Google OAuth IdP integration -- blocked, needs a real Google OAuth client/account to test against, not started). WMS-9 (HIGH, WmsOffice screen-parity sweep) has ONLY decision-gated tracks left, each needing an owner scope call before any build starts: (1) C5/C6/C7 Expedicao-side auto-generation + dynamic-CD-offer surfaces, (2) N5/N6 shell polish (quick-access bar; self-service password-change menu entry -- note a PasswordResetController.java already exists in NPDevRuntimeHost but was never traced to confirm it's the right logged-in-user self-service shape vs. a logged-out forgot-password flow, check that before building), (3) whether Z1-Z6 Reset is worth building at all for a pre-1.0 platform (excluir-estabelecimento.html exists but is the wrong shape -- a full establishment-decommission tool, not a soft reset). If picking WMS-9 back up, ask the user which of these three tracks (if any) to pursue -- do not unilaterally commit scope. A fresh WmsOffice instance was left running at http://127.0.0.1:8100 (built from generated-finalapps/wmsoffice, fresh empty H2 DB) with a bootstrapped admin user (admin/Teste123!, via the self-disabling /api/auth/bootstrap-admin endpoint) and a throwaway dev JWT keypair generated via openssl at App/wmsoffice-keys/ (regeneration will wipe that keypair again per REG-220's known, still-unfixed gap -- redo the openssl genpkey/rsa workaround if rebuilding this instance).
blocked: SEC-11 (Google OAuth) blocked on needing a real Google OAuth client/account to test against -- not attempted this session, same as prior sessions.
verified: Narrow tests only, no full gate (consistent with prior sessions' norm of targeted platform fixes, not full-gate runs mid-session). REG-216: AggregateWorkbenchExpansionTest 11/11 green (dsl), BusinessUiEmitterWorkbenchTest 3/3 green (generator) -- both confirmed via test-results XML. WMS-9 N4 clock: BusinessUiEmitterShellVersionTest 4/4 green including the new shellTopbarCarriesALiveClock test, and confirmed the existing byte-identical-across-models/version-stamp tests in the same suite still pass unmodified. All three fixes also independently code-reviewed (code-review skill, no findings survived). Live browser verification (ScrapForAI, real headless Chromium, not REST simulation) for both REG-216 (clicking New on WmsOffice's MovimentoSelection now lands on MovimentoWorkbench.html?id=new with zero server round-trip and zero console/page errors, job_RI7J05ZlzjrI, screenshots saved) and WMS-11 (a full keyboard-only 4-posicao multi-origin/multi-destination MVL entry against real seeded stock, each mechanic proven via captured row ids and cross-row value checks, not just absence-of-crash; Recalcular Saldos -> Balanced.; Save correctly fails on the already-filed WMS-9 PosicaoDentroDoMaximo corpus defect with a verbatim business-language message).
